proposal.summary: A vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after the upstream's visibility was changed to private. Affected versions were all versions prior to 3.10.0; fixed in 3.9.4, 3.8.9, 3.7.16 and 3.6.18.
proposal.cwe_quote: An authorization/sensitive information disclosure vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or review a proof-of-concept and internal impact assessment showing what repository contents could be read and whether any additional privileges or preconditions are required for exploitation.

evidence_quotes.quote: An authorization/sensitive information disclosure vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a fork to retain read access to an upstream repository after its visibility was changed to private.
This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.10.0 and was fixed in versions 3.9.4, 3.8.9, 3.7.16 and 3.6.18.
This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.
